paite: Huchi in Khrist thubulte gen nawn lou in pichin lam i manoh ding uh; thilhih sisate kisikna, Pathian lam a ginna,
heading: Pichin Lam Manoh Ni
english: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let us press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

paite: baptisma leh khutngak leh misi thohnawnna leh tangtawn vaihawmna lam thuhilhnate suangphum phum nawn lou in.
english: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

paite: Pathian in pha asakleh huai bang i hih ngei ding uhi.
english: This will we do, if God permits.

paite: Khatvei hihvak a om khin a, van thilpiak chiamta, Kha Siangthou dong khin a,
heading: Puksan Lauhuaina
english: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

paite: Pathian thuhoihna leh hun hong om ding a thilhihtheihnate chiam khin hinapi,
english: and tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the age to come,

paite: ginna akihei mangsan ualeh huchibang mite zaw akisikna ding ua bawl thak theih ahi kei uhi; Pathian Tapa amau a ding a kilhlum tuan nawn a selphou ahih ziak un.
english: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

paite: Lou, atung ua vuahtui ke gige na dawn khin a, huai khohsak a ompa a dia nek theih anteh-louhing hon suah pen in Pathian vualzawlna atang hi.
english: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it, and brings forth a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

paite: Himahleh loulingnei leh khaulingnei asuah nak in bel aphatuam kei a; hamsiat in a-om ding a, atawpna halmang ahi ding hi.
english: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

paite: Himahleh deihtakte aw, huchibang thu gen mah leng nou zaw huai thilte sang a hoihzaw hotdamna toh kizui thilte nei na hih uh ka muang uhi.
english: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

paite: Amin ziak a itna a nna na sep uleh misiangthoute nna na sepsak uh na latsak uh leh tutan a leng nasep lai uh mangngilh ding in Pathian mitak lou ahi kei hi.
english: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

paite: Himahleh atawp tan a lametna theihchetna kim mu ding in na thanop ngeingei bang un thanop suah gige chiat le uchin ka chi uhi.
english: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

paite: Huchi in na kithadahsak kei ding ua, ginna leh kuhkalna ziak a thuchiamte gouluah khin khawngte entonte na hi zaw ding uhi.
english: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and patience inherited the promises.

paite: Pathian in Abraham kiang a thu achiam lai in, amah sang a thupizaw lou a akichiam theih louh ziak in, amah-le-amah kilou in akichiam hi.
heading: Pathian Thuchiam En In
english: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by none greater, he swore by himself,

paite: Taktak in ka hon vualzawl ngeingei ding a, hih leng ka hon hihpung ding chi in akichiamta hi.
english: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.” Genesis 22:17

paite: Huchi in kuhkaltak a athuakkhiak nung in, thilchiam amuta hi.
english: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

paite: Mihingte zaw asang ua thupizawte min lou in akichiam ua; akiselna chiteng uah leng hihkipna ding in kichiam tuh thutawp ahi.
english: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

paite: Huchi in Pathian in athiltup hihlamdan tuan theihlouhdan nakpi mahmah a theihsak ut in thuchiam gouluah dingte kiang ah kichiamna apalaisak hi.
english: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath;

paite: Pathian thugen zuauthei vual ahihlouhna ah thil kikhek lamdang thei lou nihte ziak in, i ma a lametna koih lenkip ding a bitna ding a amah delhte'n hanthawnna thupitak i neihtheihna ding in ahi.
english: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

paite: Huai lametna hinna sikkip in i nei ua, muanhuai leh kiptak ahi, huai lametna puanzak sung ah leng alutta hi.
english: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil;

paite: I ma a na paita Jesu, mun siangthoupen ah i makaipa a alut tak man in Melkizedek omdan bang in eite a ding in tangtawn a siampu lianpen ana hita hi.
english: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
